references.text: Describes the same measures for drink offerings: a quarter hin of wine for a lamb, a third hin for a ram, and half a hin for a bull.
Earlier in the same chapter, the drink offering is mentioned in connection with the daily offering.
Refers to drink offerings of wine as part of the sacrificial regulations.
Mentions a drink offering of wine as a quarter hin in connection with grain offerings.
Refers to monthly burnt offerings that were to be presented before the Lord.
Describes burnt offerings on new moon days in accordance with the regulations.
Ezekiel's vision describes offerings on the new moon day involving a bull, a ram, and a lamb.
Command to blow trumpets on new moon days and at burnt offerings.
The new moon is mentioned as a set feast in Israel.
